relationship.original_equation: Liquid securities ratio = approved readily marketable securities / specified deposit liabilities
relationship.translation_notes: The result is a base-one fraction and can exceed one.

models.title: Comparable-store aggregate sales growth
models.summary: The exhibit describes year-over-year sales growth for stores open in both periods.

relationship.original_equation: Comparable-store sales growth = current comparable-store sales / prior comparable-store sales − 1
relationship.locator: Statistical Measures, Same Store Sales Growth
relationship.translation_notes: Growth is a signed base-one fraction for the comparison period.

variables.definition: Growth in aggregate sales for the same set of stores
variables.context: Same security, currency, nominal/real basis, timing and period frequency as other quantities in this relationship

assumptions: Current and prior sales cover the same eligible set of stores, comparable periods and a consistent currency basis.
limitations: This aggregate method weights individual store growth by prior sales and need not equal the simple average of individual store growth rates.
Store eligibility, closures, online revenue, currency and 53-week adjustments vary by operator.
